LESSON: SANCTITY OF LIFE

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Living
Topic 5.3: Sanctity of Life
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sanctity of Life, part of Christian Living in Grade 6 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: How can you uphold the sanctity of life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

1. team up to outline practices

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. team up to outline practices

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sanctity of Life together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
• Respect is nurtured as learners portray a caring attitude towards self and others.

• Responsibility is exhibited as learners make a decision to uphold the sanctity of life.

• Love is inculcated as learners honour God’s commandment to respect the right to life

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Human rights and responsibilities: are nurtured as learners discuss, in small groups, practices that violate the right to life and

report to the class.

Links to other Learning Areas:
• English: communication skills are enhanced as learners debate on the topic, ‘ The effects of violating the right to life’.

• Social Studies skills are enhanced as learners learn about the right to life.
